name: identity
description: The same on both sides. The least abstract relation, so it scores 0 rather than its conceptual depth.

name: opposite
description: One side is the opposite of the other. Abstractness is the node's conceptual depth.

name: successor
description: The next one along. Abstractness is the node's conceptual depth.

name: predecessor
description: The one before. Abstractness is the node's conceptual depth.

name: diff
description: Different in some way no other relation names. It has no Slipnet node, and a flat abstractness of 50.
